name: Commercial Christmas Light Installation
metaTitle: Commercial Christmas Light Installation | Ontario Firms
metaDescription: Insured, WSIB-compliant commercial Christmas light installation for London Ontario and GTA businesses. Custom quote, after-hours installs available now.
heroIntro: Insured, WSIB-compliant installation of roofline and building-outline lighting for storefronts, plazas, offices and other commercial properties.
intro: Commercial properties need holiday lighting installed on a different scale and schedule than a house. We work with storefronts, plazas, office buildings, hotels, restaurants, car dealerships, banks, malls, HOAs and condo corporations, churches, and municipalities, lighting rooflines and building outlines, wrapping trees, and installing lit cone trees where a property calls for a bigger centrepiece. Because our crews carry bucket trucks and aerial lifts, tall commercial rooflines and mature trees are handled the same way a single-storey home would be.

Every business is fully insured and WSIB-compliant working on your property, and we offer after-hours and overnight installs so lighting goes up without disrupting foot traffic, tenants or business operations. Commercial work is always custom-quoted, starting with either a site visit or a review of your property's photos or plans, and multi-year programs are available if you would rather set the lighting plan once and have it maintained annually going forward.
included: Tree wraps and lit cone trees
After-hours and overnight installation to avoid disrupting operations
Bucket trucks and aerial lifts for tall rooflines and structures
One point of contact managing your account
Maintenance, removal and storage available as part of the program

sections.heading: How commercial installation works
sections.text: We start with either a site visit or a review of photos and plans of your property, since commercial buildings vary widely in roofline shape, height, and the number of trees or structures involved. From there we plan the layout, whether that is a full building outline, roofline-only lighting, or a combination with tree wraps and cone trees, and schedule installation around your operating hours. After-hours and overnight installs are common for retail and office properties so lighting goes up without customers, tenants or staff working around ladders and lifts during the day.

sections.heading: How commercial pricing works
sections.text: Commercial jobs are custom-quoted rather than following a fixed package, since a small storefront, a multi-building plaza, and a large office complex all require very different scopes of lighting, crew time and equipment. Pricing depends on the linear footage of building outline, height and access requirements for bucket trucks or aerial lifts, the number of trees being wrapped, and whether you want a single-season install or a multi-year program. We provide a firm quote after the site visit or plan review, before any work is scheduled.

sections.heading: What to expect on install day
sections.text: Our crews are insured and WSIB-compliant on every property, and we coordinate scheduling with your property manager or point of contact so installation timing works around your business, whether that means after-hours access, overnight work, or a specific window between tenant deliveries. Equipment like bucket trucks and aerial lifts is brought in as needed for taller rooflines or structures. Once installed, lighting is tested before our crew leaves, and any maintenance, removal or storage arrangements are confirmed as part of your program.

pricing: Commercial lighting installation is always a custom quote, priced after a site visit or a review of photos and plans of your property. Cost depends on building size, roofline height and access, the number of trees or structures involved, and whether you want a single-season install or a multi-year program. There is no standard commercial rate since properties vary too widely for a fixed price.

faq.q: Do you work with property management companies and not just individual businesses?
faq.a: Yes. We regularly work with property managers overseeing plazas, office buildings, HOAs and condo corporations, and can coordinate with a single point of contact managing multiple properties or tenants under one account, rather than negotiating separately with each individual business or unit on site. This is especially useful for portfolios with several buildings under one management company.

faq.q: Can installation happen after hours or overnight?
faq.a: Yes, after-hours and overnight installs are common for commercial properties specifically so lighting work does not interfere with customer traffic, tenants or daytime business operations. We schedule around your hours when planning the install, whether that means early mornings, evenings, or full overnight access, and confirm the timing with your point of contact ahead of time.

faq.q: Are your crews insured to work on commercial property?
faq.a: Yes. Every crew is fully insured and WSIB-compliant, and we carry bucket trucks and aerial lifts for taller commercial rooflines and structures that would otherwise require specialized access equipment most residential-focused installers do not have on hand. Documentation is available for your property manager or insurer if it is needed before work begins.

faq.q: How do you quote a large or multi-building property?
faq.a: We start with either a site visit or a review of your property's photos or plans, then quote based on the full scope, building outline length, number of trees, height and access needs across every structure involved. Multi-year programs are available if you want the same lighting plan maintained annually without requoting each season.
